tools.name: afuel_token
tools.description: The official mint address of AgentFuel ($AFUEL) on Solana, with the launch wallet and links. Other tokens can copy the name or ticker; only this mint is AFUEL. Free, does not count toward the daily limit.

tools.name: rugcheck
tools.description: Risk score (0-100) for a Solana token mint: mint/freeze authority and holder concentration. Automated on-chain checks, not financial advice.

tools.name: rugcheck_robinhood
tools.description: Risk score (0-100) for an ERC-20 token on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663): verified source, upgradeable proxy, owner, mint/blacklist/fee functions, holder concentration (contracts such as pools are left out) and, when known, the Uniswap v4 pool hook. Automated on-chain checks, not financial advice.

tools.name: latest_launches
tools.description: Newest pump.fun token launches with creator, dev-buy share and risk score, newest first.

tools.name: latest_launches_robinhood
tools.description: Newest tokens on Robinhood Chain (new Uniswap v4 pools: Pools.trade launches and graduated launchpad tokens) with a rug-check risk score, newest first.

tools.name: safe_buy
tools.description: Before a bot buys a Solana token: rug-checks the token and has Presign Guard check the buy transaction the bot is about to sign. Returns one verdict: green (no red flags), orange (ask the user first) or red (do not sign), with the reasons. Nothing is signed or sent. Automated checks, not financial a

tools.name: presign_check
tools.description: Green, orange or red verdict for a Solana transaction your bot is about to sign, such as the buy after a rug-check. Red: do not sign. Orange: ask the user first. Nothing is signed or sent. Powered by Presign Guard (presign-guard.fizzl.eu, by Fizzl: fizzl.eu), which has the full report with reasons.

tools.name: injection_check
tools.description: Green, orange or red verdict for a text your agent received (a token description, web page, tool result or another agent's message): does it try to make the agent ignore its instructions, pay or hand over keys? Powered by Presign Guard.

tools.name: x402_check
tools.description: Does this paid x402 endpoint work for a paying agent? Pass, warn or fail with the main problems. Never pays the endpoint. Powered by x402 Doctor (x402-doctor.fizzl.eu, by Fizzl: fizzl.eu), which has the full report.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: injection_check · Private data: afuel_token, rugcheck, rugcheck_robinhood, latest_launches, latest_launches_robinhood, safe_buy, injection_check · Public sink: latest_launches.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: injection_check · Private data: afuel_token, rugcheck, rugcheck_robinhood, latest_launches, latest_launches_robinhood, safe_buy, injection_check · Public sink: latest_launches

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
